runtime_metrics.keyspace_searched: integer string; unique candidates covered by checkpoints
runtime_metrics.active_workers: currently RUNNING workers contributing measured throughput
runtime_metrics.exhaustion_hours: projected exhaustive-search time at current measured throughput
runtime_metrics.probability_observed: observed collision probability from completed unique work
runtime_metrics.probability_24h: forward 24h collision probability using measured RUNNING throughput
runtime_metrics.expected_collision_candidates: birthday-bound expected samples to first collision
